title: Segmentation fault when using tagbar

labels.name: needs:repro
labels.description: We need minimal steps to reproduce the issue

labels.name: bug-crash
labels.description: issue reporting a crash or segfault

body:
- `nvim --version`: NVIM v0.2.0-160-ga3b58cd
- Vim (version: ) behaves differently?
- Operating system/version: Linux Mint 18.1 Cinnamon 64-bit
- Terminal name/version: gnome terminal 3.18.3
- `$TERM`: xterm-256color

### Actual behaviour
Segmentation fault
### Expected behaviour
No segmentation fault
### Steps to reproduce using `nvim -u NORC`

```
nvim lib/controller.js
:w
wait about 10 seconds
<Esc>
```
I see plugin error:
```
Error detected while processing function <SNR>85_AutoUpdate[52]..<SNR>85_ProcessFile[26]..60:                                 
line   28:                                                                                                                    
E716: Key not present in Dictionary: kinds                                                                                    
Press ENTER or type command to continue                                                                                       
Error detected while processing function <SNR>85_AutoUpdate[52]..<SNR>85_ProcessFile[26]..60:                                 
line   28:                                                                                                                    
E15: Invalid expression: a:typeinfo.kinds
``` 
After pressing of `<Enter>` I see segfault.
